title: 轻敲会恢复：更像什么故障？
titleEn: It recovers when tapped: which fault is more likely?
prompt: 灯有时亮有时不亮，轻敲板边又好了。下面哪个判断更合理？可以随后在维修关卡里用万用表核实。按公开资料整理。
promptEn: The lamp works intermittently and recovers when the board edge is tapped. Which reading is more reasonable? You can then confirm it with a meter in the repair level. Compiled from public information.

questions.prompt: 这种‘轻敲恢复’更常见于？
questions.promptEn: This ‘recovers when tapped’ symptom is more often seen with?

options.zh: 虚焊或冷焊，接触随机械扰动变化
options.en: A cold solder joint whose contact changes with mechanical disturbance

options.zh: 电池电压精确等于门槛值
options.en: The battery voltage sitting exactly on a threshold

title: 线束弯折处间歇性断电
titleEn: Intermittent power loss at a tight bend in the harness
prompt: 设备一走动就重启，线束在铰接处弯得很紧。更应该先查什么？按公开资料整理。
promptEn: The device reboots when it starts moving, and the harness has a tight bend at a hinge. What should you check first? Compiled from public information.

options.zh: 弯折处导线是否过细、外皮是否破裂，弯折半径是否过小
options.en: Whether the wire at the bend is too thin, the jacket is cracked, or the bend radius is too tight

options.zh: 把电机电压再提高一档
options.en: Raise the motor voltage by one step

title: 八爪鱼能开机但不走路：先查电池电压
titleEn: The octopus powers on but will not walk: check the battery voltage first
prompt: 八爪鱼指示灯能亮，舵机却没劲、不迈步。更合理的第一步是什么？做完可进入对应维修关卡。按公开资料整理。
promptEn: The octopus indicator lights, but the servos have no strength and it will not take a step. What is the more reasonable first step? You can then open the matching repair level. Compiled from public information.

options.zh: 先量电池或电源在空载和带舵机负载时的电压，电压过低就先充电或更换，再查别的
options.en: Measure the battery or supply voltage with no load and with the servos connected; if it is too low, charge or replace it before looking for other faults

options.zh: 先改固件把步态幅度加到最大
options.en: Change the firmware to the largest gait first

options.zh: 先把所有舵机同时拆下来换新

title: 焊点看着完整，走线却是开路
titleEn: The joint looks intact but the trace is open
prompt: 焊点外观正常，量对应焊盘到下一颗零件却是开路。更可能是焊盘起翘或铜皮断裂。下一步怎么核实？按公开资料整理。
promptEn: The joint looks fine, but the pad measures open to the next part. A lifted pad or broken copper is more likely. How would you confirm it? Compiled from public information.

questions.promptEn: The safer way to confirm it?

options.zh: 用表从焊盘沿走线逐段量通断，并用放大镜看焊盘边缘是否离开基板
options.en: Measure continuity along the trace from the pad, and use a magnifier to see if the pad has lifted off the board

options.zh: 直接加大烙铁温度再焊一次
options.en: Turn the iron up and solder the joint again

options.zh: 更换整块电源模块，不再测量
options.en: Replace the whole power module without measuring

title: 稳压模块一插上就烫手：会不会是输出被焊锡桥短接？
titleEn: The regulator gets hot as soon as it is plugged in: is the output bridged?
prompt: 一块低压稳压模块刚插上（输入仍是直流低压）就很快发烫。输出端两焊盘看起来很近。更稳妥的做法？本题不涉及市电。按公开资料整理。
promptEn: A low-voltage regulator module gets hot almost as soon as it is plugged in (the input is still low-voltage DC). The two output pads look very close. What is the safer action? This task does not involve mains. Compiled from public information.

options.zh: 先断电，用放大镜看出端有没有焊锡桥，再用表量输出正负是否短路，确认后再考虑通电
options.en: Power down first, inspect the output pads for a solder bridge, and measure whether the output is shorted, before considering applying power again

options.zh: 先加大输入电压看它还烫不烫
options.en: Raise the input voltage to see if it still gets hot

options.zh: 先用手按住发热的芯片继续通电
options.en: Hold the hot chip down by hand and leave the power on
